name: Talking Too Much
overview: Scripture warns against excessive and careless speech, highlighting the wisdom of restraint and the dangers of unguarded words. The psalmist prays for God to guard his mouth, recognizing the need for divine help in controlling speech. Proverbs teaches that many words often lead to sin, while those who hold their tongues show wisdom and preserve their lives. Furthermore, gentle and measured responses can defuse anger, whereas harsh words provoke it, underscoring the power of speech to either build up or destroy. True understanding is marked by sparing words and a calm spirit, contrasting with the poverty that results from idle talk.
